verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page states directly that including a Jira issue key in commits updates the Jira issue status automatically, which is the core of this story. Built-in Jira management inside Bitbucket backs this up. The claim appears only as a short marketing statement, with no supporting depth or outside confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on configuring smart-commit transitions and workflow mapping, independent or hands-on confirmation that status updates work as claimed, and evidence of support for issue trackers other than Jira.
